prompt: In the five-number summary of $\{3,\ 4,\ 5,\ 6,\ 7,\ 8,\ 9\}$, what is the **median**?
hint: The median in a five-number summary is the ordinary median: the middle of the sorted values.

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Try a shorter list first: for $3, 4, 5$, which value has the same number of values on each side?
The median in a five-number summary is the ordinary median: the middle of the sorted values.
The seven values $3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9$ are in order. The middle one is in position $4$, with three values on each side.
The fourth value is $6$, so the median is $6$.

explanation: The five-number summary lists the minimum, $Q_1$, the median, $Q_3$ and the maximum.
The data is sorted and has $7$ values, so the median is the $4$th value.
Counting along $3, 4, 5, 6$, the $4$th value is $6$, so the median is $6$.
